name: secretlink
description: SecretLink monorepo - version source of truth
author: Nicolas BARRAT

scripts.integration:up: docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.integration.yml up -d --wait db && npm --prefix server run migrate:test
scripts.usine: npm run version:check && npm run integration:up && npm run test:integration && npm run test:unit && npm run integration:down
scripts.usine:full: npm run usine && npm run e2e:up && npm run test:e2e && npm run e2e:down
